units.source_text: 五个舞姬入宫参见时的仪式非常隆重。

en.t: The ceremony when the five dancing girls entered the palace to pay their respects was extremely grand.

units.source_text: 各人的服饰各出心裁，华美无比。

en.t: Each one's costume showed its own ingenuity and was incomparably splendid.

units.source_text: 讲到容貌，大家盛称源氏太政大臣家的和按察大纳言家的最为美丽。

en.t: As for their looks, everyone loudly praised the girls from Genji the Grand Minister's household and from the Inspector Grand Counselor's household as the most beautiful.
Both of them were indeed very charming.

units.source_text: 然而讲到天真与娇艳，大纳言家的毕竟比不上源氏家惟光的女儿。

en.t: Yet in innocence and delicate allure, the girl from the Grand Counselor's household could not, after all, compare with Koremitsu's daughter in Genji's household.

units.source_text: 因为她打扮得十分雅致而又时髦，样子比她的身份高贵得多，其美丽无可比拟，所以大家如此赞誉。

en.t: Because she was dressed with great elegance and fashionable taste, looked far more noble than her rank, and possessed incomparable beauty, everyone praised her in this way.

units.source_text: 原来今年所选的舞姬，年龄都比往年的稍长，因此给人特殊的美感。

en.t: It turned out that the dancing girls chosen this year were all a little older than in previous years, which gave them a distinctive beauty.

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣入宫观赏五节舞蹈时，回忆起从前五节舞会中那个筑紫少女，便在第四天正式舞会的辰日，写一封信送给她。

en.t: When Genji the Grand Minister entered the palace to watch the Gosechi dances, he remembered the girl from Tsukushi at a former Gosechi festival, and on the Dragon Day of the fourth day's formal dance gathering he wrote and sent her a letter.

units.source_text: 信中的言词可想而知，所附的诗是：

en.t: The words of the letter may be imagined; the poem attached to it was:
